title: Chinese Offensive Language Detection: Current Status and Future Directions

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing benchmarks like the Sina Weibo Sexism Review (SWSR) dataset, which annotates social media posts for sexism, sexism categories, and target types to train and evaluate sexist speech detection models.

Surveying cross-cultural transfer learning studies that evaluate how language models learn culture-specific biases by translating datasets across languages (e.g., Chinese to English) and analyzing the models' zero-shot and few-shot adaptation abilities.

Examining general offensive language benchmarks like the Chinese Offensive Language Dataset (COLD) that include annotations for anti-bias and offensive content specifically related to race, gender, and region.
Discussing knowledge-based computational models that seek to combat implicit biases and negative stereotypes by incorporating common sense knowledge into language processing.
